header.title: Other open source projects in the AEC
header.desc: OpenAEC is not the only one. Here are emerging open source BIM and CAD projects from other companies, institutes and communities: who is behind them, when they started, how many people contribute and how many stars they have on GitHub.

chart.title: GitHub stars per project
chart.sub: Stars are a rough measure of reach, not of quality. Hover over a bar for the details.

table.note: Started = date of the first commit in the public git history; a project may have begun earlier. Contributors = number of contributors to the repository according to GitHub. The figures are updated automatically; missing a project? Write to info@open-aec.com.
